review_notes: I read the whole file and compared the proof bodies. The case-split proofs of `integralNormalization_coeff_mul_leadingCoeff_pow` (lines 100-112) and `integralNormalization_mul_C_leadingCoeff` (lines 114-125) have the same shape: split_ifs, then i < degree, then a tsub arithmetic goal. Their arithmetic differs, and the shared final branch is only a routine one-liner. Extracting a helper would just move duplicated branches into a lemma, so I did not report them. The one clear duplication is the `Finset.sup_le ... support_integralNormalization_subset` degree-bound block, which appears in `degree_integralNormalization` and `monic_integralNormalization`. I checked the `monic_of_natDegree_le_of_coeff_eq_one` signature in Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/Degree/Operations.lean. I could not compile the proposed rewrite, and the duplicated block is small, so the finding is of modest size.

findings.declaration: Polynomial.monic_integralNormalization (duplicating the degree bound from Polynomial.degree_integralNormalization)
findings.excerpt:
(Finset.sup_le fun i h =>
      WithBot.coe_le_coe.2 <| le_natDegree_of_mem_supp i <| support_integralNormalization_subset h)
findings.problem: The proof of `monic_integralNormalization` re-derives `degree (integralNormalization p) ≤ natDegree p` with a hand-written `Finset.sup_le` / `WithBot.coe_le_coe` / `le_natDegree_of_mem_supp` / `support_integralNormalization_subset` chain. The same chain was already used a few lines earlier, at lines 85-86, to prove `degree_integralNormalization`. That lemma, and `natDegree_integralNormalization` at line 89, are already available and state exactly the degree bound that `monic_integralNormalization` needs. So the support-to-degree reasoning is written twice, which obscures that the monic result follows directly from the degree-preservation lemmas.
findings.proposed_change:
Reuse `natDegree_integralNormalization` and the existing Mathlib lemma `monic_of_natDegree_le_of_coeff_eq_one` instead of repeating the sup_le argument:

theorem monic_integralNormalization (hp : p ≠ 0) : Monic (integralNormalization p) :=
  monic_of_natDegree_le_of_coeff_eq_one p.natDegree natDegree_integralNormalization.le
    (integralNormalization_coeff_natDegree hp)

This keeps the same hypothesis `hp`. `natDegree_integralNormalization` has no extra assumptions, because its `nontriviality` step is internal. Only `degree_integralNormalization` still contains the sup_le chain, so the subset-to-degree argument appears once. (Not compiled.)
findings.benefit: The support-to-degree bound is proved in one place, so a later change to `support_integralNormalization_subset` or to the degree API needs only one edit. The monic proof shrinks to a two-line assembly of the degree and leading-coefficient facts, which makes the argument easier to read.
